requirement: The controller's identity and how to contact it about personal data
evidence: you can also contact us by post addressed to Privacy Legal Team, UTI, 1725 3rd Street, San Francisco, CA 94158
reason: The policy names Careem Technologies and Uber Technologies Inc. as controllers and gives a contact form and a postal address.

requirement: Contact details of the data protection officer (DPO)
condition: The controller has appointed a DPO
reason: No data protection officer or DPO contact details are given; only a general privacy legal team address.

requirement: The personal data that is collected
evidence: The Personal Data collected in these processes may include your:
reason: Detailed lists of the personal data collected are given in Section 3, including name, contact details, ID, location and device data.

requirement: The means used to collect personal data
evidence: In some cases, we collect this data through cookies, pixels, tags, and similar tracking technologies that create and maintain unique identifiers
reason: The policy describes collection directly from users, through app use and tracking technologies, and from third parties.

requirement: The purpose of collecting and processing personal data
evidence: We may use Personal Data collected in the manners described above to:
reason: Section 4 lists the specific purposes of processing, such as providing services, safety, fraud prevention and marketing.

requirement: The legal basis for collecting personal data (e.g. consent, contract, legal obligation)
evidence: Contractual Necessity: This basis applies when we must use your data in order to provide the services you request and meet our responsibilities under the contract to which you are a party to
reason: Section 2 lists contractual necessity, consent, legitimate interest and legal obligation as legal bases, each with examples.

requirement: Which personal data is mandatory and which is optional
reason: The policy lists the data it collects but never says which items are mandatory and which are optional.

requirement: The consequences of not providing personal data
evidence: Please note that if you choose not to provide us with some of this Personal Data, or request that we erase some or all of it, we may not be able to provide you with our Services at all, or provide it to the same standard we can if we are using that Personal Data.
reason: The policy states that withholding data may mean the Services cannot be provided or are degraded.

requirement: The parties personal data is disclosed or shared with, and their capacity
reason: Section 5 names the recipients (Affiliates, Careem Technologies, Google, vendors, authorities, Captains) and their roles, such as service providers or separate controllers.

requirement: Whether personal data is transferred, disclosed or processed outside the Kingdom
evidence: we process personal data globally. This means we may also transfer personal data to countries other than the one where you live or use theServices.
reason: The policy says data may be transferred abroad but does not specifically address transfers outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia or name destinations.

requirement: How long personal data is kept, or the criteria used to decide
evidence: We will store and retain your Personal Data for the period of time necessary for the purpose for which the data has been collected
reason: Retention is tied to the purpose of collection, which is a criterion, though no specific periods are given.

requirement: How personal data is stored and destroyed
evidence: we will erase or archive from active use the Personal Data of the individual to which the requirement or request relates
reason: Destruction after deletion requests is described, but how data is stored (methods, location, safeguards) is not.

requirement: The data subject's rights: to be informed, access, obtain a copy, correct, and request destruction
evidence: To request access to your data, including your profile data and trip history
reason: Access, correction and erasure are covered, but the right to be informed and to obtain a copy are not clearly stated.

requirement: How the data subject can exercise their rights
evidence: you may exercise these rights through the Settings menu in the Careem Technologies EverythingApp or by contacting here
reason: Exercise is explained through app settings, contact links, and the Subject Access Request form.

evidence: To revoke your consent, where we have expressly asked for your consent as a legal basis to process your Personal Data
reason: States the right to withdraw consent, and rights can be exercised via settings or contact link.

requirement: The measures taken to protect personal data
condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
evidence: Uber makes every effort to ensure that your Personal Data is secure
reason: Section 10 mentions password protection, dedicated staff and periodic security reviews, but gives no specific technical or organisational measures and disclaims any guarantee of security.

requirement: Whether decisions are made solely by automated processing
condition: Large-scale or continuous processing, monitoring, new technologies, or automated decisions
evidence: We use personal data to make automated decisions relating to use of our Services
reason: Section 6 states that automated decisions are made (ratings and deactivation, matching, dynamic pricing, fraud flagging) and gives the grounds for them.
